verdict.rationale: The evidence pack links to a GitHub repository (google-gemini/gemini-cli), but every item there describes a CLI feature. None states that the source code is published or names an open-source license. Hosting a README on GitHub does not show that readable source exists under an open license, so the applicable axis is unevidenced.
